item.title: Randle's Williams-Callis named Texas Gatorade Player of Year; national finalist
item.description: CHICAGO (December 5, 2025) — In its 41st year celebrating the nation’s best high school athletes, Gatorade today announced Landen Williams-Callis of Randle High School is the 2025-26 Gatorade Texas Football Player of the Year.
